producer_report.summary: I wrote the design note docs/design/direct-main-single-commit-landing.md, added a CHANGELOG.md entry, and appended decision D178 to docs/decisions.md. The note proposes retiring the long-lived local landing branch and building each job's single commit on fetched main with `Git::merge_tree`, taking the base from `Verified::base()`. It says `dispatched_from` and `refuse_detached` are only branch checks. It states the two preconditions of `plan` and how migration meets them. It also gives the 5.0-minute estimate, scored only as the THROUGHPUT.md median after the change against 2337.1, plus four alternatives, the conflict and failure paths, risks, and the requirement to cite review 20261113-190159-mapn. No code under crates/ changed. I ran the policy test and the mirrors test, and both passed.
